description: Saskatoon Police Service hosted a well-attended Diversity Disco event.
Chief McBride will join STC powwow and Sanctum homeless challenge.
Chief will also participate in a Métis cultural eating contest.

chips.text: Chief joked about strategy for Métis cultural neck bone eating contest.
Saskatoon Police Service members and their spouses appreciated communication.

description: Police Commission to report on up to 4% budget reductions.
Report due to City Council for early December budget meetings.
This addresses potential property tax increases for residents.

chips.text: Police budget is almost a quarter of city spending, a significant cost driver.
Residents broadly oppose a 10% property tax increase.

description: Ashu Solo provided 50 recommendations for Saskatoon Police Service.

chips.text: Commissioner Santasol suspected many recommendations were already implemented.

description: Police Commissioners' 2025 midyear budget is on track.

chips.text: Commissioner asked about 'freight' costs in the budget.
